title: VIIRS S-NPP 375 m active fire detections · Collection 2 NRT
creator: NASA LANCE / FIRMS
license: NASA Earth science data, open access
changes: Frozen 7-day global CSV retrieved 2026-10-26. Retain every nominal/high-confidence record in longitude −82…−34, latitude −56…13; no deduplication, interpolation or thinning. A bounding-box subset, not a country boundary selection. Heat sums reported FRP in MW. Detections are not independent fires, burned area or fire severity. NRT records can be revised; cloud, overpass and sensor effects affect coverage. No tracks.
